study_identification_part.si_4_title: Microstructural mapping of neural pathways in Alzheimer's disease using macrostructure-informed normative tractometry

dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: ADNI Phase 3 (sub-protocols S31, S55, S127, P33, P36, GE36, GE54); NIMHANS (Siemens and Philips scanners); TractoInferno training dataset (multi-site pretraining data).
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: In total, we analyzed diffusion data of 1032 subjects from two cohorts - 730 participants from the Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimaging Initiative (ADNI) Phase 3 ... and an independent sample of 302 Indian-ancestry participants ... NIMHANS ... this pretraining dataset consisted of 198 single-shell dMRI volumes ... TractoInferno training dataset

answer.ADNI: target dataset for fine-tuning and testing

answer.NIMHANS: target dataset for fine-tuning and testing

dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.detail: TractoInferno used for pretraining to encode normal statistical variation; ADNI and NIMHANS healthy controls (CN) used for fine-tuning (Split 1), validation (Split 2), and as healthy test samples (Split 3); MCI and dementia subjects used for testing and clinical research.
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.supporting_text: A VAE model is first trained on healthy controls from a pretraining dataset (TractoInferno). For each target dataset (ADNI, NIMHANS), the controls are split into two sets (Split 1 and Split 2), and Split 1 is used to fine-tune the VAE model. ... MCI or dementia were concatenated with the 50% CN subjects to create the test set.
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.location: Feng2025.pdf.md: 2.3.1 Macrostructure modeling; 2.3.2 Data preparation and training

dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.detail: Overall phase HC includes 198 (TractoInferno) + 447 (ADNI CN) + 123 (NIMHANS CN) = 768. Train phase HC includes 198 (pre-training) + 199 (fine-tuning, calculated as 35% of 447 ADNI CN and 35% of 123 NIMHANS CN).
dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.supporting_text: TractoInferno training dataset ... 198 single-shell dMRI volumes ... ADNI ... 447 cognitively normal (CN) participants ... NIMHANS ... 123 CN participants ... split into independent subsets of size 35%/15%/50% for training/validation/testing.
dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.location: Feng2025.pdf.md: 2.1 Participant demographics; 2.2.3 TractoInferno; 2.3.2 Data preparation and training

dc_4_age_info_of_each_normative_nodel.detail: Values for overall-phase are inferred from the total combined cohort (N=1032) stats for ADNI and NIMHANS, as healthy control-specific age stats were not reported separately. Mean and SD for the target cohorts combined were 72.12 and 8.50. Age data for the TractoInferno pretraining dataset was not provided in the paper.

dc_5_sex_info_of_each_normative_nodel.detail: Sex ratios inferred from the total combined cohort male percentage (50.97%). Overall HC N=768; Male N ≈ 391. Train HC N=397; Male N ≈ 202. Specific sex counts for healthy controls were not reported.
